domain_guidance.summary: Focus extensively on antepartum care, clinical risk factors, and prenatal assessments covering 21.0 percent of the test questions to build a solid knowledge base for managing healthy pregnancies.

Study intrapartum labor management, continuous clinical monitoring, and safe delivery processes covering 21.0 percent of the test questions to ensure optimal outcomes during the active stages of childbirth and labor.

Examine postpartum recovery processes, potential physiological complications, and ongoing maternal health covering 18.0 percent of the test questions to support new mothers effectively through the weeks following childbirth.

Review detailed newborn assessment procedures, immediate postnatal care, and neonatal transition covering 10.0 percent of the test questions to evaluate infant health accurately during the initial moments of extrauterine life.

Learn detailed gynecological evaluations, broad reproductive health concepts, and related clinical conditions covering 19.0 percent of the test questions to provide safe and effective care across the patient lifespan.

Cover standard primary care concepts, general health maintenance strategies, and patient evaluations spanning 11.0 percent of the test questions to ensure well-rounded competency in primary healthcare settings for diverse populations.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your time effectively across the 175 questions during the 240-minute duration. Check with American Midwifery Certification Board (AMCB) for testing policies and identification requirements.

faq.answer_text: There are exactly 175 questions featured on the detailed exam, distributed across six distinct clinical domains covering antepartum, intrapartum, postpartum, newborn, gynecology, and primary care specialties to ensure thorough evaluation.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: You should check directly with the American Midwifery Certification Board (AMCB) for specific and up-to-date details regarding the passing score requirements for this professional certification path.
The total exam duration is 240 minutes, giving you sufficient time to carefully complete all 175 questions across the specified clinical knowledge domains without undue haste.
The professional certification is administered by the American Midwifery Certification Board (AMCB). You can check with them directly for the current certification path and handbook details.

methodology.summary: This informative page was meticulously built using official documentation, handbooks, and precise domain weightings provided directly by the American Midwifery Certification Board (AMCB) to ensure total accuracy.

editorial.overview: The AMCB Certified Midwife Exam Practice Test is a detailed assessment designed to evaluate your clinical knowledge and readiness across six distinct domains. Certified by the American Midwifery Certification Board (AMCB), this structured evaluation consists of 175 questions and provides a 240-minute timeframe to test your overall proficiency in professional midwifery practices, patient evaluations, and standard healthcare delivery.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review each domain weight carefully to allocate your study time effectively throughout your preparation period. Focus heavily on antepartum and intrapartum care, which make up significant portions of the test questions. Use official resources provided directly by the American Midwifery Certification Board (AMCB) to guide your daily practice and ensure complete alignment with all official testing requirements.
editorial.who_should_take: This assessment is intended for individuals pursuing midwifery credentials through the American Midwifery Certification Board (AMCB). Candidates preparing for clinical practice certification should complete this practice test.
